metadata.notes: Folleto promocional del Usher's Hotel de Sydney, segundo en la serie tras un primer librito de 64 páginas. Recoge 11 cócteles exclusivos creados por la casa, ilustrados por J. C. Bancks (creador de 'Ginger Meggs'). Muchos cócteles utilizan ginebra y ron de la marca Usher's.

sections.content_original: EXCLUSIVE COCKTAILS FROM THE RECIPES OF USHER'S HOTEL. SYDNEY, 1936. USHER'S IS SYDNEY'S MOST DISTINCTIVE AND EXCLUSIVE HOTEL.
sections.content_es: CÓCTELES EXCLUSIVOS SEGÚN LAS RECETAS DEL USHER'S HOTEL. SÍDNEY, 1936. USHER'S ES EL HOTEL MÁS DISTINGUIDO Y EXCLUSIVO DE SÍDNEY.

sections.title: Preface
sections.content_original: Some time ago we published a small booklet of sixty-four pages, in which we gave over fifty of the exclusive cocktail recipes which were responsible for building the reputation that Usher's enjoys for its distinctive Cocktails dispensed on the First Floor Lounge. Although some thousands of these booklets were printed, the demand for them from every State in Australia and from England, America and other oversea countries, was so great that not a single copy is available to-day. Encouraged by this success, we have now produced this present booklet in which we are releasing the recipes of eleven of our most exclusive cocktails that have won great popularity over the last few months. Usher's trust that you will like these latest eleven creations — each recipe being 'different' to the ones that are usually known. These cocktails are quite distinctive, and are really delightful and refreshing. We wish to acknowledge the courtesy of Mr. J. C. Bancks, the creator of 'Ginger Meggs,' who illustrates our booklet. H. H. Welman, General Manager. Usher's Hotel, Sydney.
sections.content_es: Hace algún tiempo publicamos un pequeño folleto de sesenta y cuatro páginas en el que ofrecíamos más de cincuenta de las recetas exclusivas de cócteles responsables de la reputación que disfruta Usher's por sus distinguidos cócteles servidos en el Lounge del Primer Piso. A pesar de que se imprimieron varios miles de ejemplares, la demanda procedente de todos los estados de Australia y de Inglaterra, América y otros países de ultramar fue tan grande que hoy no queda un solo ejemplar disponible. Animados por este éxito, hemos preparado el presente folleto, en el cual damos a conocer las recetas de once de nuestros cócteles más exclusivos que han alcanzado gran popularidad en los últimos meses. Usher's confía en que estas once nuevas creaciones serán de su agrado: cada receta es 'distinta' a las habitualmente conocidas. Son cócteles muy característicos, realmente deliciosos y refrescantes. Queremos agradecer la amabilidad del Sr. J. C. Bancks, creador de 'Ginger Meggs', que ilustra nuestro folleto. H. H. Welman, Director General. Usher's Hotel, Sídney.

sections.title: Hints on Mixing Cocktails
sections.content_original: In making a Cocktail, the most essential factor is to observe the correct proportions as set out in these recipes. All ingredients should be poured into a cocktail shaker, which should be shaken vigorously — not merely rocked. The object is to wake the mixture up — not to send it to sleep. Crushed ice should be added in the shaker when making any Cocktail. To obtain the greatest enjoyment from a Cocktail, it should be partaken immediately it is poured from the shaker. 'Drink it while it is still laughing at you,' is the maxim of one of England's greatest cocktail connoisseurs. Where white of egg is used in any recipe, the mixture should be shaken longer than usual. About five minutes is generally required to make the white of egg properly beaten. In the case of cream Cocktails, it is advisable to add the cream last when pouring the ingredients into the shaker. A dash of Angostura bitters may be added to any Cocktail. This improves the flavour and accentuates the pleasing effect of the different ingredients. The proportions given in the recipes are those that should give a pleasing Cocktail, suitable for the average taste. These proportions may be varied if it is desired to alter the flavour, but, generally speaking, in no case should greater quantities of any Liqueur be used than those stated.
sections.content_es: Al preparar un cóctel, el factor más esencial es respetar las proporciones correctas indicadas en estas recetas. Todos los ingredientes deben verterse en una coctelera, que debe agitarse con energía, no solo balancearse. El objetivo es despertar la mezcla, no dormirla. Debe añadirse hielo picado en la coctelera al preparar cualquier cóctel. Para disfrutar al máximo de un cóctel, hay que tomarlo en cuanto se sirve de la coctelera. 'Bébelo mientras todavía se ría de ti' es la máxima de uno de los mayores conocedores ingleses de cócteles. Cuando una receta lleva clara de huevo, debe agitarse más tiempo de lo habitual; suelen requerirse unos cinco minutos para batirla adecuadamente. En el caso de los cócteles con nata, conviene añadir la nata al final al verter los ingredientes en la coctelera. Puede añadirse un chorrito de amargo de Angostura a cualquier cóctel: mejora el sabor y acentúa el efecto agradable de los distintos ingredientes. Las proporciones indicadas son las que deberían dar un cóctel agradable, apto para el gusto medio. Estas proporciones pueden variarse si se desea modificar el sabor, pero, en general, nunca deben emplearse cantidades mayores de licor que las indicadas.

sections.title: Atmospheric Presentation of Cocktails
sections.content_original: Should you desire to surprise your guests when entertaining them at your next Cocktail Party, may we suggest an idea which has proved successful with clients for whom we have had the pleasure of arranging Cocktail Parties. For instance, should you desire to serve a 'White Lady' Cocktail, to cover the Cocktail shaker with the Crinoline skirt of an attractively dressed doll creates an atmosphere for the title of the cocktail. A cocktail shaker, concealed in a crepe-paper pink rose automatically suggests the title for this cocktail, 'Pink Rose.' A very humorous atmosphere for a blood-hound cocktail can be obtained by the use of a grotesque toy dog. These suggestions will indicate how you can effectively secure an atmospheric presentation of Cocktails that will delight and intrigue your guests. The number of different forms of presentation are infinite, because you can draw on your imagination indefinitely.
sections.content_es: Si desea sorprender a sus invitados en su próxima fiesta de cócteles, permítanos sugerirle una idea que ha tenido éxito con los clientes para los que hemos tenido el placer de organizar fiestas de cócteles. Por ejemplo, si desea servir un cóctel 'White Lady', cubrir la coctelera con la falda de crinolina de una muñeca atractivamente vestida crea una atmósfera acorde con el nombre del cóctel. Una coctelera disimulada dentro de una rosa rosada de papel crepé sugiere automáticamente el título del cóctel 'Pink Rose'. Para un cóctel 'Blood-Hound' se puede crear un ambiente muy humorístico usando un perro de juguete grotesco. Estas sugerencias muestran cómo lograr una presentación ambiental de los cócteles que deleitará e intrigará a sus invitados. Las formas de presentación son infinitas, pues puede recurrir a su imaginación sin límites.

ingredients.notes: una cantidad igual al total de los demás ingredientes

recipes.method_original: Take two-sixths of a measure of Usher's Rum, one-sixth of a measure of Red Curaçao and one-sixth of a measure of Grenadine. Add a good dash of Cloves and a dash of Orange Bitters. To this add an equal quantity of milk. Ice and shake well.
recipes.method_es: Tome dos sextos de medida de ron Usher's, un sexto de medida de curaçao rojo y un sexto de medida de granadina. Añada un buen golpe de clavo y un golpe de amargo de naranja. Agregue a esto una cantidad igual de leche. Hielo y agite bien.
recipes.glassware: copa de pie alto escarchada con azúcar
recipes.raw_text:
BLOOD AND SAND

Take two-sixths of a measure of Usher's Rum one-sixth of a measure of Red Curaco and one-sixth of a measure of Grenadine. Add a good dash of Cloves and a dash of Orange Bitters. To this add an equal quantity of milk. Ice and shake well.

Serve in a long-stemmed glass, crusted with sugar. Serve with a piece of preserved fruit.

ingredients.notes: una clara por cada dos personas
unas pocas gotas, añadidas antes de agitar

recipes.method_original: To two-sixths of a measure of Usher's Gin add one-sixth of a measure of Cointreau, one-sixth of a measure of Absinthe, and two-sixths of a measure of lemon juice, and the white of a fresh egg for each two persons. Ice and shake well and serve with a Maraschino Cherry on two small drinking straws in a champagne glass. The particularly fascinating feature of this cocktail is its appearance. An azure blue is obtained by carefully adding, before shaking, a few drops of a blue colouring. This ingredient is used just as one would use yokine when cooking.
recipes.method_es: A dos sextos de medida de ginebra Usher's añada un sexto de medida de Cointreau, un sexto de medida de absenta y dos sextos de medida de zumo de limón, junto con la clara de un huevo fresco por cada dos personas. Ponga hielo y agite bien; sirva con una cereza al marrasquino sobre dos pequeñas pajitas en una copa de champán. La característica especialmente fascinante de este cóctel es su aspecto: se obtiene un azul cielo añadiendo con cuidado, antes de agitar, unas pocas gotas de colorante azul. Este ingrediente se utiliza igual que se usaría una yema al cocinar.
recipes.garnish: cereza al marrasquino sobre dos pajitas pequeñas
recipes.raw_text:
BLUE HEAVEN

To two-sixths of a measure of Usher's Gin add one-sixth of a measure of Cointreau, one-sixth of a measure of Absinthe, and two-sixths of a measure of lemon juice, and the white of a fresh egg for each two persons.
Ice and shake well and serve with a Maraschino Cherry on two small drinking straws in a champagne glass.

The particularly fascinating feature of this cocktail is its appearance. An azure blue is obtained by carefully adding, before shaking, a few drops of a blue colouring. This ingredient is used just as one would use yokine when cooking.

ingredients.notes: una clara por cada dos personas

recipes.method_original: To four-eighths of a measure of orange juice, add one-eighth of a measure of Apricot Brandy, one-eighth of a measure of Cointreau, one-eighth of a measure of Usher's Gin, one-eighth of a measure of French Vermouth and the white of a fresh egg to each two persons. Ice and shake well. Serve in a champagne glass sprinkling hundreds and thousands on top of the mixture.
recipes.method_es: A cuatro octavos de medida de zumo de naranja, añada un octavo de medida de brandy de albaricoque, un octavo de medida de Cointreau, un octavo de medida de ginebra Usher's, un octavo de medida de vermut francés y la clara de un huevo fresco por cada dos personas. Ponga hielo y agite bien. Sirva en una copa de champán, espolvoreando grageas multicolor sobre la mezcla.
recipes.garnish: grageas multicolor (hundreds and thousands) espolvoreadas por encima
recipes.raw_text:
FLYING COLOURS

To four-eighths of a measure of orange juice, add one-eighth of a measure of Apricot Brandy, one-eighth of a measure of Cointreau, one-eighth of a measure of Usher's Gin, one-eighth of a measure of French Vermouth and the white of a fresh egg to each two persons.
Ice and shake well.
Serve in a champagne glass sprinkling hundreds and thousands on top of the mixture.

recipes.method_original: To one-sixth of a measure of Brandy, add two-sixths of a measure of Apricot Brandy, two-sixths of a measure of Orange juice, and one-sixth of a measure of French Vermouth. Ice and shake well.
recipes.method_es: A un sexto de medida de brandy añada dos sextos de medida de brandy de albaricoque, dos sextos de medida de zumo de naranja y un sexto de medida de vermut francés. Ponga hielo y agite bien.
recipes.garnish: una rodaja fina de naranja en el borde de la copa
recipes.raw_text:
KOALA

To one-sixth of a measure of Brandy, add two-sixths of a measure of Apricot Brandy, two-sixths of a measure of Orange juice, and one-sixth of a measure of French Vermouth.

Ice and shake well.

Serve a small slice of orange on the edge of the glass.

ingredients.notes: un sexto de la medida; aporta el característico color púrpura

ingredients.item_es: sirope de fruta de la pasión (maracuyá)

recipes.method_original: Take two-sixths of a measure of Usher's Gin, one-sixth of a measure of Parfait Amour and add three-sixths of a measure of Passion-fruit syrup. Ice and shake well.
recipes.method_es: Tome dos sextos de medida de ginebra Usher's, un sexto de medida de Parfait Amour y añada tres sextos de medida de sirope de fruta de la pasión. Ponga hielo y agite bien.
recipes.glassware: copa escarchada con azúcar de color púrpura
recipes.garnish: trozo de jengibre confitado flotando por encima
recipes.raw_text:
KOOKABURRA

Take two-sixths of a measure of Usher's Gin, one-sixth of a measure of Parfait Amour and add three-sixths of a measure of Passion-fruit syrup.
Ice and shake well.
Serve in a glass crusted with purple sugar. A piece of Preserved Ginger should be floated on top of the cocktail. The unusual purple colour of this cocktail is obtained by using Bols Parfait Amour.

recipes.method_original: Take one-third of a measure of Usher's Gin, and add one-third of a measure of Creme de Banana, and one-third of a measure of cream, and a few drops of bright yellow colouring. Ice, shake well, and serve in a glass crusted with yellow sugar.
recipes.method_es: Tome un tercio de medida de ginebra Usher's y añada un tercio de medida de crema de plátano, un tercio de medida de nata y unas pocas gotas de colorante amarillo intenso. Ponga hielo, agite bien y sirva en una copa escarchada con azúcar amarillo.
recipes.garnish: rodaja fina de plátano flotando sobre el cóctel
recipes.raw_text:
LAZY DAISY

Take one-third of a measure of Usher's Gin, and add one-third of a measure of Creme de Banana, and one-third of a measure of cream, and a few drops of bright yellow colouring.
Ice, shake well, and serve in a glass crusted with yellow sugar.
A thin slice of banana should be floated on top of the cocktail.

ingredients.notes: una clara por cada dos personas

recipes.method_original: Take two-eighths of a measure of Usher's Gin, one-eighth of a measure of Italian Vermouth, one-eighth of a measure of Apricot Brandy, one-eighth of a measure of Kummel, one-eighth of a measure of Orange Curacao, and to this mixture add two-eighths of a measure of Grenadine and the white of a fresh egg for each two persons. Ice and shake well for at least five minutes.
recipes.method_es: Tome dos octavos de medida de ginebra Usher's, un octavo de medida de vermut italiano, un octavo de medida de brandy de albaricoque, un octavo de medida de kümmel, un octavo de medida de curaçao de naranja y, a esta mezcla, añada dos octavos de medida de granadina y la clara de un huevo fresco por cada dos personas. Ponga hielo y agite bien durante al menos cinco minutos.
recipes.glassware: copa de champán escarchada con azúcar rosa
recipes.garnish: cereza al marrasquino colocada en la copa sobre dos pequeñas pajitas
recipes.raw_text:
MAGIC NOTES

Take two-eighths of a measure of Usher s Gin, one-eighth of a measure of Italian Vermouth, one-eighth of a measure of Apricot Brandy, one-eighth of a measure of Kummel, one-eighth of a measure of Orange Curacao, and to this mixture add two-eighths of a measure of Grenadine and the white of a fresh egg for each two persons.
Ice and shake well for at least five minutes.
Serve in champagne glass crusted with pink sugar. A Maraschino cherry should be placed in the glass on two small drinking straws.

recipes.method_original: With three-sixths of a measure of Usher's Gin use one-sixth of a measure of Maraschino, and two-sixths of a measure of grape juice. Ice and shake well.
recipes.method_es: Con tres sextos de medida de ginebra Usher's, emplee un sexto de medida de marrasquino y dos sextos de medida de zumo de uva. Ponga hielo y agite bien.
recipes.glassware: copa escarchada con azúcar blanco en polvo para darle aspecto 'brumoso'
recipes.raw_text:
MOON MIST

With three-sixths of a measure of Usher's Gin use one-sixth of a measure of Maraschino, and two-sixths of a measure of grape juice.
Ice and shake well.
With this cocktail serve a sugared grape.
The popularity this cocktail enjoys, we attribute entirely to the use of the grape juice, which is almost unique in cocktail recipes.
The glass should have a 'misty' appearance which is obtained by crusting with a powdered white sugar.

recipes.method_original: Take two-sixths of a measure of a good Amontillado Sherry, one-sixth of a measure of Italian Vermouth, two-sixths of a measure of grenadine and one-sixth of a measure of absinthe. Ice and shake these ingredients well in a shaker, serving with an olive.
recipes.method_es: Tome dos sextos de medida de un buen jerez Amontillado, un sexto de medida de vermut italiano, dos sextos de medida de granadina y un sexto de medida de absenta. Ponga hielo y agite bien estos ingredientes en una coctelera; sirva con una aceituna.
recipes.raw_text:
NEW LIFE

Take two-sixths of a measure of a good Amontillado Sherry, one-sixth of a measure of Italian Vermouth, two-sixths of a measure of grenadine and one-sixth of a measure of absinthe.
Ice and shake these ingredients well in a shaker, serving with an olive.
This cocktail has become exceedingly popular because of the ever increasing popularity of sherry, which, until recently, was only appreciated by connoisseurs.

recipes.method_original: With three-sixths of a measure of Usher's Gin use two-sixths of a measure of cream, and one-sixth of a measure of Creme-de Menthe. Ice and shake well, but not for too long. Serve with a Maraschino Cherry.
recipes.method_es: Con tres sextos de medida de ginebra Usher's, emplee dos sextos de medida de nata y un sexto de medida de crema de menta. Ponga hielo y agite bien, pero no durante demasiado tiempo. Sirva con una cereza al marrasquino.
recipes.raw_text:
WHOOPEE

With three-sixths of a measure of Usher's Gin use two-sixths of a measure of cream, and one-sixth of a measure of Creme-de Menthe.
Ice and shake well, but not for too long.
Serve with a Maraschino Cherry.

recipes.method_original: Take two-sixths of a measure of Usher's Rum, two-sixths of a measure of French Vermouth, one-sixth of a measure of Cointreau, and to this mixture add one-sixth of a measure of lemon juice. Ice and shake well.
recipes.method_es: Tome dos sextos de medida de ron Usher's, dos sextos de medida de vermut francés, un sexto de medida de Cointreau y añada a esta mezcla un sexto de medida de zumo de limón. Ponga hielo y agite bien.
recipes.glassware: copa escarchada con azúcar de color
recipes.garnish: pequeño cubo de piña en almíbar flotando sobre el cóctel
recipes.raw_text:
WIDOW'S KISS

Take two-sixths of a measure of Usher's Rum, two-sixths of a measure of French Vermouth, one-sixth of a measure of Cointreau, and to this mixture add one-sixth of a measure of lemon juice.
Ice and shake well.
Serve in glass crusted with coloured sugar.
Float a small cube of Preserved Pineapple on top of the cocktail.
